svg.aria-label: 竖直长剑、麦穗徽饰与完整中国国徽
svg.title: Monumental vertical sword with bound grain and complete national emblem
svg.desc: The sword, blade relief, grain bundles and guard share one upright axis. The complete national emblem is centered in front of the blade, without damage or penetration. The right region remains empty for the separate poem.
